name: 翻译助手
description: 翻译插件：对话即译 + 文档级翻译（译文落 sys-hub 工作空间 translator/translations/（收敛点批 2026-10-10，存量在「翻译/」），MD5 缓存命中秒回；面板一键直翻走免费快引擎）+ 领域方案术语包（软件/IT·学术·商务，翻译自动按对照执行）

zh-CN.translator.config.selection_enabled: 选中文字后显示「翻译」浮层
zh-CN.translator.config.selection_enabled.desc: 应用内选中文字（编辑器/预览等）后浮出「翻译」按钮，点击即译（免费快引擎，默认自动互译方向）；快捷键触发同效（默认 Ctrl+Shift+Alt+T，实际生效键位见「设置 → 快捷键」）。开启后配置变更刷新页面生效
zh-CN.translator.config.bilingual: 文档翻译双语交错（原文+译文对照）
zh-CN.translator.config.bilingual.desc: 开启后文档翻译产出为双语交错格式（每段先原文后译文，对照学习/朗读友好）；缓存按模式区分，切换后同文档首次翻译会重新生成
zh-CN.translator.usage:
**能干什么**：把外文资料变成可检索、可出题的中文知识资产（定位：资料中文化 + 译文资产化）。

**怎么用**：
1. 对话即译：对白泽说「把这段话翻译成中文」（或任意应用复制文本后划词快捷键触发，补一句「翻译」；快捷键默认值与实际生效键位见「设置 → 快捷键」）——只输出译文、术语保护、格式保真；
2. 文档翻译：对白泽说「翻译 <文档名>」——自动检查缓存（源文档未变更秒回），未命中则按批给出素材、逐批翻译后自动落盘 sys-hub「翻译/<源仓库>/」，译文头部可回跳源文档，入库即可检索、可出题；
3. 默认自动互译方向（中文源→英文，其他→中文），也可指定「译成日文」。

**说明**：翻译由当前 Agent 模型完成（消耗模型配额，长文档分批多轮）；无需配置任何翻译服务密钥。

en-US.translator.config.selection_enabled: Show the "Translate" popup on text selection
en-US.translator.config.selection_enabled.desc: Selecting text in the app (editor/preview etc.) shows a "Translate" button that translates on click (free fast engine, auto direction by default); the hotkey does the same (default Ctrl+Shift+Alt+T, effective key on "Settings → Shortcuts"). When on, config changes apply after a page refresh
en-US.translator.config.bilingual.desc: Document translation outputs interleaved bilingual format (each paragraph: source then translation — friendly for study and read-aloud); cache is per-mode, so the first translation of the same document after switching regenerates

en-US.已有译文直接打开（源文档未变更时 MD5 命中秒回，按已保存内容判定）；首次翻译: Open an existing translation directly (MD5 cache hit when the source document is unchanged, judged by saved content); for a first translation tell Baize "Translate <doc name>" or click "Hand to Baize" on a miss — it opens here once done. One-click direct translation via the free fast engine sends the source text to MyMemory (an overseas public service): choosing "Yes" under "Outbound Transfer Consent" consents to the transfer (one-time consent, not asked again); keep "No" to stay local and use the AI quality track (a configured model; never touches MyMemory).
en-US.翻译插件：对话即译 + 文档级翻译（译文落 sys-hub 工作空间 trans: Translator: translate-as-you-chat + document-level translation (output lands in the sys-hub workspace at translator/translations/ (consolidated 2026-10-10; legacy items under '翻译/'), MD5 cache hits return instantly; the panel's one-click direct translation uses the free fast engine) + domain glossary packs (software/IT · academic · business, applied automatically during translation).
en-US.领域方案（启用后该领域高频术语自动按对照翻译，自定义术语始终优先）: Domain Packs (once enabled, high-frequency terms in that domain are translated by the glossary automatically; custom terms always take priority)
en-US.未启用。启用示例：软件/IT 包会把 prompt 统一译为「提示词」。对应用内: Not enabled. Example: the Software/IT pack translates "prompt" as "提示词" consistently. Applies to in-app translation; the outside-app selection popup is not covered
en-US.批量导入（每行一条：术语<分隔符>译名；支持从 Excel 直接复制两列粘贴）: Bulk Import (one entry per line: term<separator>translation; paste two columns copied straight from Excel)
en-US.同名术语覆盖既有译名；无法解析的行逐行披露，不影响其余行入库；支持从 Excel: Duplicate terms overwrite existing translations; unparseable lines are reported one by one without blocking the rest; paste two columns copied straight from Excel
en-US.输入文本即时翻译（免费快引擎，默认自动互译方向；划词与输入翻译共享缓存，同文本秒: Translate text on the spot (free quick engine, auto direction by default; shares the cache with selection translation — the same text returns instantly)
en-US.翻译历史（sys-hub「翻译/」，点击行查看译文）: Translation History (sys-hub "Translations/"; click a row to open the translation)
en-US.添加术语（翻译时自动强制按对照翻译，对话中也可用 manage_terms 管理: Add Term (enforced in translation automatically; also manageable via manage_terms in chat)
en-US.命中的术语将按既定译名翻译（如 prompt→提示词）。对应用内翻译生效；应用外: Matched terms are translated with the fixed translation (e.g. prompt→提示词). Applies to in-app translation; the outside-app selection popup and the free quick engine do not enforce it
